_comment: Research: research point tuning and the tech tree (the Lab room is in rooms.json). Typed in src/sim/systems/research.ts; see docs/design/M6-spec.md. Effects use the keys in src/sim/bonuses.ts (BonusEffect). A Lab makes (sum of worker Wits) x pointsPerWitsHour x levelMult[level] x (1 + researchSpeed) points per hour. Deep rooms are gated by their own requiresResearch; unlocks.rooms here is for display.

branches.name: Industry
branches.description: More power, food and water from the same tired residents.

branches.name: Medicine
branches.description: Stronger patches, better cures and hardier residents.

branches.name: Defense
branches.description: Tougher doors, steadier nerves and fewer trips to the Clinic.

branches.name: Automation
branches.description: The homestead looks after itself, so the Warden can look after the homestead.

branches.name: Expeditions
branches.description: Further, safer and richer trips into the Glarelands.

branches.name: Deep Works
branches.description: Surveys, taps and farms below the twenty-five charter floors.

nodes.name: Dynamo Tuning
nodes.description: Generators produce 10% more power. The procedure is one firm tap with the regulation wrench, in the regulation spot.

nodes.name: Standardized Recipes
nodes.description: Canteens produce 10% more food. Every stew is now the same stew, which HALCY describes as a triumph of consistency.

nodes.name: Triple-Stack Filters
nodes.description: Waterworks produce 10% more water. The taste is unchanged, and nobody has decided whether that is good news.

nodes.name: Ring Main Grid
nodes.description: Generators produce 15% more power. Every room now sits on one big loop, so a blown fuse is everybody's problem.

nodes.name: Hydroponic Trays
nodes.description: Canteens produce 15% more food. The lettuce grows in nutrient broth under a sun lamp and has never once complained.

nodes.name: Pressure Reclaimers
nodes.description: Waterworks produce 15% more water. Condensation, run-off and shower steam all come back for another go.

nodes.name: Modular Construction
nodes.description: Rooms cost 10% less to build and upgrade. Halcyon parts now fit other Halcyon parts, as the brochure always claimed.

nodes.name: Shift Whistles
nodes.description: All production rooms work 8% faster. A whistle at the start, a whistle at the end, and a very long whistle if anyone dawdles.

nodes.name: Bottled Sun Reactor
nodes.description: Generators produce 25% more power and every production room works 5% faster. A small star in a large jar. Please do not tap the glass.

nodes.name: Triage Cards
nodes.description: Med-Patches and Purge work 15% better at home. Colour-coded cards show at a glance who is dying and who is merely loud.

nodes.name: Patch Press
nodes.description: Clinics produce 15% more Med-Patches. The press used to be a waffle iron. On Sundays it still is.

nodes.name: Chelation Drip
nodes.description: Purge Labs produce 20% more Purge. The drip binds the Glare in your blood and carries it off to somewhere less important.

nodes.name: Halcyon Vitamin Program
nodes.description: New residents start with 10 more max HP. The vitamins are orange. The vitamins have always been orange.

nodes.name: Glare Serum
nodes.description: Med-Patches and Purge work another 25% better at home. Side effects include a faint glow and an urge to fill in surveys.

nodes.name: Marrow Reinforcement
nodes.description: New residents start with 20 more max HP, and Med-Patches and Purge work 10% better at home. Bones now meet Halcyon load-bearing standards.

nodes.name: Reinforced Gaskets
nodes.description: The homestead door has 25% more HP against raids. The seal is now rated for weather, pressure and people with crowbars.

nodes.name: Fire Drills
nodes.description: Residents take 5% less damage from incidents. They also know where the exits are, which is new for everyone.

nodes.name: Calisthenics Hour
nodes.description: Residents gain 10% more XP. Attendance is voluntary and also checked.

nodes.name: Blast Door Mk. II
nodes.description: The homestead door has 50% more HP against raids. Now with a second, slightly smaller door inside the first one.

nodes.name: Hazard Certification
nodes.description: Residents take 10% less damage from incidents. Every resident now holds a laminated card saying they know what they are doing.

nodes.name: Deep Bracing
nodes.description: Residents take 10% less damage from incidents, and deep-floor threats come less often and hit softer. Struts, shoring and hard hats for all, which matters most where the ceiling is solid rock.

nodes.name: Door Sentry Array
nodes.description: The homestead door has 100% more HP, and residents take 5% less damage from incidents. The sentries are polite, patient and armed.

nodes.name: Holding Tanks
nodes.description: Production rooms can hold one extra finished batch, so nothing goes to waste while you are away.

nodes.name: Personnel Office
nodes.description: Every minute, idle residents are assigned to the free job that best suits them. The office has one desk, one stamp and no appeals process.

nodes.name: Overflow Tanks
nodes.description: Production rooms can hold another extra finished batch. The overflow tanks have their own overflow tanks.

nodes.name: Punch-Card Tabulator
nodes.description: Labs produce 15% more research points. It sorts ten thousand cards a minute and hums when it is happy.

nodes.name: Supply Bots (Mk. I)
nodes.description: Supply bots patch up anyone below half health and purge anyone badly Glare-sick, using Med-Patches and Purge from storage. One resident every ten seconds, with a cheerful beep.

nodes.name: Strategic Reserve Tanks
nodes.description: Production rooms can hold a third extra finished batch. HALCY has named each tank and would like you to learn the names.

nodes.name: Night Shift Protocols
nodes.description: Offline catch-up covers 24 more hours. The homestead keeps working while you sleep, and so, apparently, do the residents.

nodes.name: Pneumatic Conveyors
nodes.description: Finished batches collect themselves while you play. The tubes go thunk, and the storeroom fills up.

nodes.name: The Thinking Machine
nodes.description: Labs produce 25% more research points and offline catch-up covers 24 more hours. It fills a whole room, thinks in valves and has asked twice to meet the Warden.

nodes.name: Aluminium Pack Frames
nodes.description: Explorers carry 15 more before heading home. Light, strong and only slightly bent.

nodes.name: Lead-Lined Ponchos
nodes.description: Explorers take 15% less taint in the Glarelands. Heavy, but so is Glare-sickness.

nodes.name: Prospector's Almanac
nodes.description: Explorers find 15% more scrip. A well-thumbed guide to which ruins are worth kicking.

nodes.name: Field Surgery Kits
nodes.description: Med-Patches heal 15% more on quests, and downed members get up stronger. Each kit includes a stick to bite.

nodes.name: Dispatch Desk
nodes.description: One more contract on offer at each refresh. The desk takes calls from the whole neighbourhood and a few from beyond it.

nodes.name: Polarised Glare Goggles
nodes.description: Explorers take 20% less taint and carry 10 more. The sky is still on fire, just less so from the inside.

nodes.name: Deputy Wardens
nodes.description: Run one more quest at a time. Each deputy gets a badge, a clipboard and exactly as much authority as the Warden says.

nodes.name: Deep Survey
nodes.description: Opens excavation of the first stratum below the homestead. The charter says twenty-five floors. The charter does not say why.

nodes.name: Second Stratum Survey
nodes.description: Opens excavation of the second stratum, and the Aquifer Pump that draws on the water down there. The core samples are warm, and the survey team would like that noted.

nodes.name: Geothermal Taps
nodes.description: Unlocks the Geothermal Tap, a deep room that draws power from the rock itself. The rock has not been asked.

nodes.name: Fungal Farming
nodes.description: Unlocks the Fungal Farm, a deep room that grows food in the dark. The mushrooms are nutritious, filling and faintly beige.

nodes.name: Pneumatic Drills
nodes.description: Excavation runs 25% faster. Louder, too, but the rock was never going to complain.

nodes.name: Third Stratum Survey
nodes.description: Opens excavation of the third stratum. The old Halcyon plans stop here and start again, in a different hand, forty metres lower.

nodes.name: Ore Refining
nodes.description: Unlocks the Ore Refinery, a deep room that turns Knack and raw rock into steel, circuitry and the occasional surprise.

nodes.name: Fourth Stratum Survey
nodes.description: Opens excavation of the fourth stratum. Every copy of the old plans has this page removed. Halcyon regrets any inconvenience.

achievements.name: Halcyon Fellowship
achievements.description: Complete all 46 research projects in one homestead.

achievements.name: Below the Charter
achievements.description: Complete every Deep Works project in one homestead.

achievements.name: Human Resources
achievements.description: Have the Personnel Office assign 50 residents.
